title: No internet on one PC
symptom: One PC has no internet while colleagues are working fine
user_description: I can't open any websites on my computer, but the person next to me is online with no problem.

options.why: Disrupts everyone in the office to fix one PC. Others are online, so the router is clearly working.
Far too drastic. Never start with the most destructive fix.

options.text: Check this PC's network cable or Wi-Fi connection, and restart the network connection or the PC
options.why: Because colleagues are fine, the fault is almost certainly on this PC or its connection. Checking the cable or Wi-Fi and restarting are quick, safe first steps.
Pointless when other people have internet. The provider cannot fix a problem on one PC.

hints: Is everyone affected, or only this PC?
How does this PC connect to the network?
real_world_tip: Asking 'Is anyone else affected?' is the fastest way to decide whether the problem is the PC or the network.
